headline: Stop calculating the risk of bending down.
subline: Pick your kid up without holding your breath.
A personalized recovery plan for lasting relief.

icp.name: David
icp.persona: The Hesitant Dad / Active Avoidance Sufferer
icp.friction: Calculates the risk before picking up his son or tying shoes.
icp.emotionalOutcome: Spontaneous confidence to move with his kid without holding his breath.

copy.primaryText:
When was the last time you bent down without holding your breath?

If you have a toddler, a desk job, or a back that flares up every few weeks, you know the feeling: that split-second calculation before you bend over to pick up a toy, grab your keys, or lift your kid.

Random YouTube stretches don't fix that. They give you 10 minutes of relief before the stiffness resets.

Remedy builds a personalized recovery plan from your pain history and daily habits. 8 to 12 minutes a day. Follow the video on your iPhone.

Get your back back.

copy.description: A personalized recovery plan for lasting relief.

headline: You just cracked your back for the 7th time today.

icp.name: Maya
icp.persona: The Desk Worker / Temporary Relief Trap
icp.friction: Cracks their back and rolls out just to feel relief that resets within minutes.
icp.emotionalOutcome: Sitting through a workday without thinking about their back.

copy.primaryText:
Twisting in your chair. Cracking your lower back against the backrest. Using a foam roller before bed.

It feels good for about 8 minutes. Then you sit back down, and the exact same dull throb returns.

Cracking your back feels like relief, then the ache comes right back. That's why you're doing it 10 times a day.

Remedy gives you a short daily back program built from your answers. Real stability, so you can sit through work and forget you have a lower back.

headline: Your lower back shouldn't be your first thought every morning.
subline: Roll out of bed without testing your spine first.

icp.emotionalOutcome: Waking up unburdened, without a mental body check.

copy.primaryText:
Alarm rings. Before your feet touch the floor, you do the mental scan: How stiff is it today? Is this going to be an okay day, or a slow day?

Your back shouldn't dictate how your morning starts.

Remedy takes your pain history, movement patterns, and schedule and builds a short daily recovery routine. Right from your bedroom or living room.

No waiting rooms. No random exercises.
